howToPlay: Use the basic attack to blast targets with exploding cactus spikes. Deploy the Super to damage enemies while slowing their movement within the area. Utilize the Fertilize star power to recover health or the Curveball star power to increase accuracy with curving spikes.
gears: Equip Damage to boost output when low on health, Shield for extra protection, and Sticky Spikes to maximize crowd control capabilities.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who prefer a high-damage control specialist that excels at area denial.
